text: Connecting a repository gives automatic AI-driven reviews on pull requests
quote: Connect a repository and get automatic product reviews on your pull requests.

text: PR review appears as a GitHub check with a 1-5 score and P0/P1/P2 findings
quote: The GitHub check and summary show a score out of 5 with actionable P0, P1, and P2 findings.

text: Each finding explains what was expected, what the code does, and how to fix the gap
quote: Findings explain what was expected, what the code does, and how to resolve the gap.

text: Reviews can be re-triggered by pushing new commits or commenting @foreloop retest
quote: Push changes or have a repository writer comment @foreloop retest.

text: PR checks are advisory by default; org admins can opt into a failure threshold
quote: Checks are advisory by default; an organization owner or admin can opt into a failure threshold.

text: A PR can be linked to a tracked intention via a description marker, CLI command, or PR comment
quote: Link the PR using Foreloop-Intention: YOUR-REF in its description, Link PR in the intention, or @foreloop link YOUR-REF.

text: Official CLI manages projects, loops, intentions, stories and tasks, usable by scripts, agents, and cron
quote: Projects, loops, intentions, stories and tasks from a terminal — and from anything that can run one, including coding agents and cron.

text: CLI supports a --json flag on every command with a stable, additive-only output shape
quote: --json works on any command and has a stable shape. Additive changes only.

text: CLI returns meaningful exit codes (ok, failed, auth, usage, confirmation) for scripting
quote: Exit codes are meaningful: 0 ok, 1 failed, 2 auth, 3 usage, 4 confirmation required.

text: A FORELOOP_TOKEN env var overrides stored credentials so CI pipelines need no login step
quote: `FORELOOP_TOKEN` outranks any stored credential, so CI needs no login step.

text: Embedded feedback widget lets end users describe a problem and submit it without leaving the page
quote: Your users press it, describe a problem, and send — without leaving the page or filing anything anywhere.

text: Widget installs with a single script tag, requires no build step, and updates live without redeploying
quote: One tag, and we serve the widget... Nothing to build, and published fixes reach your site without you redeploying.

text: Official feedback SDK installable via npm (@foreloop/feedback)
Widget API keys are scoped to signal:write only, safe to expose in browser code or repos
quote: A widget key carries only the signal:write scope — it can submit feedback and nothing else, which is why it may live in browser code and in your repository.

text: An AI agent reads a feedback submission, auto-fills a new intention, and proposes tasks from it
quote: An intention starts from the report, and its agent reads the submission, fills in the intention, and proposes the tasks

text: Widget submissions can be routed to a specific project or fall back to the org's general feedback list
quote: Pick a project on that page and submissions route to that project. Leave the project unset and submissions arrive in your organization's Feedback list instead

text: Submissions are triaged as real or spam/noise, with spam automatically dismissed
quote: real, or spam and noise. Spam is dismissed here and goes no further.

text: Product review integrates into existing GitHub PR workflow without changing your process
quote: Keep your current process. Foreloop brings product context and review into the tools you already use, starting with your GitHub pull requests.
